titre_page: How do I create a sound effect? | Yop2D guide
description: In Yop2D, the sound effect editor builds a laser, a jump or a coin with sliders, or tweaks a sound from a royalty-free pack, then saves it as .ogg.
carte: A laser, a jump, a coin: build or tweak your sound.
etapes: Choose a sound in the list and move the sliders.
"Create the sound (.ogg)", then play it with a node.
blocs: A laser, a jump, a coin pickup… With the sound effect editor, you **build** a sound with sliders, or you **pick an existing sound and tweak it**, without leaving Yop2D. It needs Android 10 or later.
In the **Assets** window, tap the **Sound FX** button. (You also find it when you choose a node's sound: **Sound FX** button, then **Use this sound effect**.)
On the left, a **Search a sound…** field and the list of sounds sorted in groups. Tapping a sound **picks it and plays it**.
On the right you see the shape of the sound and its settings.

The **My adjustable retro sounds** group holds 9 starter sounds: Laser, Jump, Coin, Explosion, Power-up, Hit, Click, Alarm, Teleport. Choose the **Sound shape** (Soft, Square, Saw, Triangle, Noise) then move the 7 sliders: Pitch, Slide, Length, Vibrato, Grit, Echo, Note jump. The sound plays again when you lift your finger.
The **Random** and **Vary a little** buttons try sounds for you, and **Undo** goes back.

Under the retro sounds, the **⬇ Download … more sounds** line downloads a pack of 435 royalty-free (CC0) sounds: impacts, footsteps, objects, interface, voices… It weighs 3.5 MB, is downloaded only once and needs internet. These sounds have simpler settings: Pitch, Speed, Echo, Volume, Trim the start, Trim the end.
Tap **Create the sound (.ogg)**, give it a name and choose the **Folder** (Sons by default).
The sound effect is now an ordinary sound file: use the [[jouer_son]] node and pick it.
To change it later: **Open** in the editor.
When you tweak a sound from the pack, its license (CC0) is copied into your project along with it.
